ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast; approximately 70% high-intensity (white/cream) to 30% low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white base on both lobes, bifurcated by a low-intensity black central column. other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique large yellowish-tan pigmentation zones contrasting against the white ventral fluke surface.
